author: blu
body: Proves Braingeyser: X-draw, the self-draw mirror of Mind Twist. "Draw X cards." compiles to DrawX. It is castable only with mana to spare beyond the fixed cost; casting pours all remaining mana into X and the caster draws that many cards. With three blue floating over a {1}{U} fixed cost, X = 3, so a five-card library yields three fresh cards in hand.
